# OrganoidNeuralNetworkDynamics

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The emergent spatiotemporal activity patterns, including neuronal avalanches, observed in organoid cultures as a proxy for cortical dynamics. Offers a scalable experimental platform to validate self-organized criticality models relevant to in-network neuromorphic computing architectures.
